types.label: Direct notification to the phone
types.description: A notification a session, the CLI, MCP or a voice command sent straight to the phone (phone.notify).

types.label: Phone paired or revoked
types.description: A phone claimed a pairing code, or a paired phone was revoked or forgotten.

types.label: Phone offline
types.description: The paired phone has not polled the console for a while, so pushes, approvals and the recorder cannot reach it.

types.label: Phone command failed
types.description: A command sent to the phone (open a page, notification, recorder, voice) failed or timed out.
